verses.geez: ወከመ፡ ወሬዛ፡ ሀየል፡ ውስተ፡ አድባር፡ ድኁኃን። ቅንጽ፡ አንተ፡ ወልድ፡ እኁየ፡ ከመ፡ ወይጠል። በዐራትየ፡ ወበለያልይየ። አኀሥሥ፡ ዘአፍቀረት፡ ነፍስየ። ኀሠሥክዎ፡ ወኢረከብክዎ። ጸዋዕክዎ፡ ወኢተሰጥወኒ።
verses.translation: By night on my bed I sought him whom my soul loves: I sought him, but found him not; I called him, but he hearkened not to me.

translations.lxx: By night on my bed I sought him whom my soul loves: I sought him, but found him not; I called him, but he hearkened not to me.
translations.kjv: By night on my bed I sought him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.
translations.ron: Noaptea-n pat l-am căutat pe dragul sufletului meu, l-am căutat, dar, iată, nu l-am mai aflat.
translations.grk: Ἐπὶ κοίτην μου ἐν νυξὶν, ἐζήτησα ὃν ἠγάπησεν ἡ ψυχή μου· ἐζήτησα αὐτὸν, καὶ οὐχ εὗρον αὐτόν· ἐκάλεσα αὐτὸν, καὶ οὐχ ὑπήκουσέ μου.

verses.geez: እትነሣእ፡ ወአዐውድ፡ ሀገረ። ውስተ፡ ምሥያጣት፡ ወውስተ፡ መራሕብት። እኅሥሥ፡ ዘአፍቀረት፡ ነፍስየ። ኀሠሥክዎ፡ ወኢረከብክዎ። ጸዋዕክዎ፡ ወኢተሰጥወኒ።
verses.translation: I will rise now, and go about in the city, in the market-places, and in the streets, and I will seek him whom my soul loves: I sought him, but I found him not.

translations.lxx: I will rise now, and go about in the city, in the market-places, and in the streets, and I will seek him whom my soul loves: I sought him, but I found him not.
translations.kjv: I will rise now, and go about the city in the streets, and in the broad ways I will seek him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.
translations.ron: Scula-mă-voi, mi-am zis, şi-n târg voi alerga, pe uliţe, prin pieţe, amănunţit voi căuta pe dragul sufletului meu. L-am căutat, nu l-am mai aflat.
translations.grk: Ἀναστήσομαι δὴ καὶ κυκλώσω ἐν τῇ πόλει, ἐν ταῖς ἀγοραῖς, καὶ ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις, καὶ ζητήσω ὃν ἠγάπησεν ἡ ψυχή μου· ἐζήτησα αὐτὸν, καὶ οὐχ εὗρον αὐτόν.

verses.geez: ረከቡኒ፡ መዓቅብት፡ እለ፡ የዐቅቡ፡ ሀገረ። ርኢክሙኑ፡ ዘአፍቀረት፡ ነፍስየ።
verses.translation: The watchmen who go their rounds in the city found me. I said, Have ye seen him whom my soul loves?

translations.lxx: The watchmen who go their rounds in the city found me. I said, Have ye seen him whom my soul loves?
translations.kjv: The watchmen that go about the city found me: to whom I said, Saw ye him whom my soul loveth?
translations.ron: Întâlnitu-m-am cu paznicii, cei ce târgul străjuiesc; "N-aţi văzut, zic eu, pe dragul sufletului meu?"
translations.grk: Εὕροσάν με οἱ τηροῦντες, οἱ κυκλοῦντες ἐν τῇ πόλει. Μὴ ὃν ἠγάπησεν ἡ ψυχή μου, ἴδετε;

verses.geez: ንስቲተ፡ ኀሊፍየ፡ እምኔሆሙ። ይእተ፡ ጊዜ፡ ረከብኩ፡ ዘአፍቀረት፡ ነፍስየ። አኀዝክዎ፡ ወኢየኀድጎ። እስከ፡ ሶበ፡ አባእክዎ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ እምየ። ወውስተ፡ ውሳጥያቲሃ፡ ለእንተ፡ ሐፀነተኒ።
verses.translation: It was as a little while after I parted from them, that I found him whom my soul loves: I held him, and did not let him go, until I brought him into my mother's house, and into the chamber of her that conceived me.

translations.lxx: It was as a little while after I parted from them, that I found him whom my soul loves: I held him, and did not let him go, until I brought him into my mother's house, and into the chamber of her that conceived me.
translations.kjv: It was but a little that I passed from them, but I found him whom my soul loveth: I held him, and would not let him go, until I had brought him into my mother’s house, and into the chamber of her that conceived me.
translations.ron: Dar abia m-am despărţit de ei şi iată, eu l-am găsit, pe cel iubit; apucatu-l-am atunci şi nu l-am mai lăsat, până nu l-am dus la mama mea, până nu l-am dus în casa ei.
translations.grk: Ὡς μικρὸν ὅτε παρῆλθον ἀπʼ αὐτῶν, ἕως οὗ εὗρον ὃν ἠγάπησεν ἡ ψυχή μου· ἐκράτησα αὐτὸν καὶ οὐκ ἀφῆκα αὐτὸν, ἕως οὗ εἰσήγαγον αὐτὸν εἰς οἶκον μητρός μου, καὶ εἰς ταμεῖον τῆς συλλαβούσης με.

verses.geez: አምሐልኩክን፡ አዋልደ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም። በኀይሉ፡ ወበጽንዑ፡ ለገዳም። አመ፡ ተንሥአ፡ ወአንሥአ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሙታነ። ኣፈቅሮ፡ እስከ፡ አመ፡ ፈቀደ።
verses.translation: I have charged you, O daughters of Jerusalem, by the powers and by the virtues of the field, that ye rouse not nor awake my love, until he please.

translations.lxx: I have charged you, O daughters of Jerusalem, by the powers and by the virtues of the field, that ye rouse not nor awake my love, until he please.
translations.kjv: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.
translations.ron: Vă jur, fete din Ierusalim, pe cerboaice, pe gazelele din câmp, nu treziţi pe draga mea, până nu-i va fi ei voia!
translations.grk: Ὥρκισα ὑμᾶς θυγατέρες Ἱερουσαλὴμ ἐν ταῖς δυνάμεσι, καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἰσχύσεσι τοῦ ἀγροῦ· ἐὰν ἐγείρητε καὶ ἐξεγείρητε τὴν ἀγάπην ἕως ἂν θελήσῃ.

verses.geez: መኑ፡ ይእቲ፡ ዛቲ፡ እንተ፡ ተዐርግ፡ እምገዳም። ከመ፡ ሠርጸ፡ ጢስ፡ ዕጥነታ። ወከመ፡ ደመና፡ ዘጠፈረ፡ ሰማይ።
verses.translation: Who is this that comes up from the wilderness as pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all powders of the perfumer?

translations.lxx: Who is this that comes up from the wilderness as pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all powders of the perfumer?
translations.kjv: Who is this that cometh out of the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all powders of the merchant?
translations.ron: Cine este aceea care se ridică din pustiu, ca un stâlp de fum, par-c-ar arde smirnă şi tămâie, par-c-ar arde miresme iscusit gătite?
translations.grk: Τίς αὕτη ἡ ἀναβαίνουσα ἀπὸ τῆς ἐρήμου, ὡς στελέχη καπνοῦ τεθυμιαμένη σμύρναν καὶ λίβανον ἀπὸ πάντων κονιορτῶν μυρεψοῦ;

verses.geez: ክልኤ፡ አጥባትኪ፡ ያውኅዛ፡ ሐሊበ። ከርቤ፡ ወስኂን፡ እምኵሉ፡ ጸበለ፡ አፌኔዎስ።
verses.translation: Behold Solomon's bed; sixty mighty men of the mighty ones of Israel are round about it.

translations.lxx: Behold Solomon's bed; sixty mighty men of the mighty ones of Israel are round about it.
translations.kjv: Behold his bed, which is Solomon’s; threescore valiant men are about it, of the valiant of Israel.
translations.ron: Iat-o, este ea, lectica lui Solomon, înconjurată de şaizeci de voinici, viteji falnici din Israel.
translations.grk: Ἰδοὺ ἡ κλίνη τοῦ Σαλωμὼν, ἑξήκοντα δυνατοὶ κύκλῳ αὐτῆς ἀπὸ δυνατῶν Ἰσραήλ·

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ ዐራቱ፡ ለሰሎሞን። ስሳ፡ ኀያላን፡ ዐውዳ፡ እምኀያላነ፡ እስራኤል።
verses.translation: They all hold a sword, being expert in war: every man has his sword upon his thigh because of fear by night.

translations.lxx: They all hold a sword, being expert in war: every man has his sword upon his thigh because of fear by night.
translations.kjv: They all hold swords, being expert in war: every man hath his sword upon his thigh because of fear in the night.
translations.ron: Toţi sunt înarmaţi, la război deprinşi. Fiecare poartă sabie la şold, pentru orice întâmplare şi frică de noapte.
translations.grk: Πάντες κατέχοντες ῥομφαίαν δεδιδαγμένοι πόλεμον· ἀνὴρ ῥομφαία αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ μηρὸν αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ θάμβους ἐν νυξί.

verses.geez: ኵሎሙ፡ እኁዛነ፡ አስይፍት፡ ወምሁራነ፡ ቀትል። ብእሲ፡ ብእሲ፡ ሰይፉ፡ ዲበ፡ መንቅዕቱ። በድንጋፄ፡ ሌሊት።
verses.translation: King Solomon made himself a litter of woods of Lebanon.

translations.lxx: King Solomon made himself a litter of woods of Lebanon.
translations.kjv: King Solomon made himself a chariot of the wood of Lebanon.
translations.ron: Regele Solomon şi-a făcut tron de nuntă din lemn de cedru din Liban.
translations.grk: Φορεῖον ἐποίησεν ἑαυτῷ ὁ βασιλεὺς Σαλωμὼν ἀπὸ ξύλων τοῦ Λιβάνου·

verses.geez: መጾረ፡ ገብረ፡ ለርእሱ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ሰሎሞን፡ እምዕፀወ፡ ሊባኖስ።
verses.translation: He made the pillars of it silver, the bottom of it gold, the covering of it scarlet, in the midst of it a pavement of love, for the daughters of Jerusalem.

translations.lxx: He made the pillars of it silver, the bottom of it gold, the covering of it scarlet, in the midst of it a pavement of love, for the daughters of Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: He made the pillars thereof of silver, the bottom thereof of gold, the covering of it of purple, the midst thereof being paved with love, for the daughters of Jerusalem.
translations.ron: Stâlpii lui sunt de argint, pereţii de aur curat, patul e de purpură, iar acoperişul este de scumpe alesături; darul dragostei alese a fetelor din Ierusalim.
translations.grk: Στύλους αὐτοῦ ἐποίησεν ἀργύριον, καὶ ἀνάκλιτον αὐτοῦ χρύσεον· ἐπίβασις αὐτοῦ πορφυρᾶ, ἐντὸς αὐτοῦ λιθόστρωτον, ἀγάπην ἀπὸ θυγατέρων Ἱερουσαλήμ.

verses.geez: አዕማዲሁ፡ ገብረ፡ ዘብሩር። ሰርዲኖስ፡ ምስለ፡ ተርሴስ። ኢዮጶሎግዮስ፡ ዘምስለ፡ ሶፎር።
verses.translation: Go forth, ye daughters of Sion, and behold king Solomon, with the crown wherewith his mother crowned him, in the day of his espousals, and in the day of the gladness of his heart.

translations.lxx: Go forth, ye daughters of Sion, and behold king Solomon, with the crown wherewith his mother crowned him, in the day of his espousals, and in the day of the gladness of his heart.
translations.kjv: Go forth, O ye daughters of Zion, and behold king Solomon with the crown wherewith his mother crowned him in the day of his espousals, and in the day of the gladness of his heart.
translations.ron: Ieşiţi, fetele Sionului, priviţi pe Solomon încoronat, cum a lui maică l-a încununat, în ziua sărbătoririi nunţii lui, în ziua bucuriei inimii lui!
translations.grk: Θυγατέρες Σιὼν ἐξέλθατε, καὶ ἴδετε ἐν τῷ βασιλεῖ Σαλωμὼν, ἐν τῷ στεφάνῳ ᾧ ἐστεφάνωσεν αὐτὸν ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ, ἐν ἡμέρᾳ νυμφεύσεως αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ εὐφροσύνης καρδίας αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ምስማኩ፡ ዘወርቅ። መንበሩ፡ ዘሜላት። አቊላፊሁ፡ ወአቊላፊሁ፡ ኢያሴምር። ኅንብርቱ፡ ዘቢረሌ፡ ዘምስለ፡ ኢያሰጲድ፡ በባሕርይ፡ ክዱን። ውስጡ፡ ንጡፍ፡ በእብነ፡ ሰንፔር። ኣፈቅሮ፡ ፈድፋደ፡ እምአዋልደ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም።
ፃኣ፡ ትርአያ፡ አዋልደ፡ ጽዮን። ለንጉሥ፡ ሰሎሞን። በአክሊል፡ ዘአስተቀጸለቶ፡ እሙ። አመ፡ ዕለተ፡ ሕማሙ፡ ወአመ፡ ዕለተ፡ ስቅለቱ። ወአመ፡ ዕለተ፡ መርዓሁ፡ ወአመ፡ ዕለተ፡ ፍሥሓ፡ ልቡ።
